model.architecture: Zamba2 is Zyphra's shared-attention hybrid: a Mamba2 selective-scan backbone (32 layers) with a **single shared transformer block** applied at 6 interleaved positions — one set of attention+MLP weights reused at every position, specialized by per-position LoRA adapters, attending over the concatenation of the running hidden state and the original embeddings.

variants.quantization: int8 dynamic on linears + embedding (convs and the scan stay float); fp32 activations declared for GPU

recommended.reason: measured on one Galaxy S26 with one binary: GPU 11.6 tok/s decode / 117.2 prefill, peak 3620 MB, init 22.8 s (S4 GPU gate 2026-08-24, 1 run) against CPU 10.17-12.21 decode / 66.2-87.8 prefill, peak 3283 MB, init 2.7 s (S7 Android backfill 2026-09-05, 2 cold runs). Same-device CPU control taken: decode is a wash (within 10%); gpu is kept for its prefill advantage (time to first token), a deliberate choice rather than a decode win
